content: "In a fortnight, Donegal will set their sights on the All-Ireland final, where they will face a Kerry team that effortlessly handled Tyrone, much like how McGuinness' squad managed to defeat Meath."
{'In his first year back, Jim McGuinness saw his dream of guiding Donegal to the All-Ireland title dashed last year when they suffered a semi-final defeat against Galway.'}
